service.name: Funk band
service.serviceType: Instrumental funk and soul band for parties, after-parties and corporate events
service.description: An instrumental funk and soul band, guitar, bass and drums as a trio or a quartet with a horn or keys, for private parties, company after-parties, summer picnics and retreat evenings across Denver, the Front Range and the Colorado mountain corridor.

faqs.a: An instrumental funk and soul band booked through Signet Artists in Denver: guitar, bass and drums as a trio, or a quartet with a horn or keys, playing James Brown, the Meters, Stevie Wonder, Prince and Earth, Wind & Fire for parties, company after-parties and summer events.

No, it's an instrumental band, so the songs can run into each other for as long as the floor wants. The soul and R&B band plays the same songwriters with a singer out front and a horn on the choruses.

While people eat, it plays at a level the tables talk across, with the drums kept light. Once the floor opens it plays like a band at a party, with the bass felt at the back of the floor and the guitar kept comfortable for the front tables. It sets the level to the space and the crowd, and if your venue has a sound limit, give us the number and it stays under it.

faqs.q: How much space and power does it need?
faqs.a: The trio sets up in about 12 by 8 feet on one dedicated 20-amp circuit and needs about an hour to set up. The quartet takes about 14 by 10 feet, two dedicated circuits and 90 minutes. Sound support that's the right size for the venue comes with every booking.

Yes, and patios and lawns are a lot of its work. It needs a covered, level and dry spot with power run to it, and we agree a plan for moving indoors with you ahead of time, because a Colorado afternoon can turn fast.

faqs.q: Can we add time or ask for a song?
faqs.a: Yes. If the night runs long, another half hour is easy to add on the night, and the band learns one song of your choosing as part of every booking.
